subsection.label: A
subsection.title: Protecting Tamil Nadu's Financial and State Rights

points.title: Proportional Representation
points.description: TVK's policy is that true social justice means every community receives representation in proportion to its population. A caste-wise census (Caste Survey) will be conducted to ensure this.

points.title: Demanding Fair Fiscal Devolution for Tamil Nadu
points.description: A resolution will be passed in the Tamil Nadu Assembly demanding a fair and full share of the taxes Tamil Nadu pays to the Union government be devolved back to the state. Beyond just passing the resolution, the state will pursue this legally up to the Supreme Court if necessary, with a special legal team formed to fight and argue the case. Every rupee owed to Tamil Nadu will be systematically documented, and this will be formally declared to the Union government as an injustice done to Tamil Nadu's finances. The state will ensure it receives its rightful share of fiscal devolution from the Union government.

points.title: Tamil Nadu's Rightful Share of GST Revenue
points.description: The TVK government will firmly insist that Tamil Nadu receives its rightful share of tax revenue from the Union government. It will specifically demand that 70% of total GST revenue be allocated back to the states. It will also demand full GST compensation for revenue losses suffered by the states.

points.title: Special Steps to Move Education to the State List
points.description: Because education (including medical education) currently falls under the Union government's Concurrent List, obstacles keep arising - such as the forcing through of new education policies and controversies over entrance exams. Therefore, special steps will be taken to move education (including medical education) from the Concurrent List to the State List. This will involve working together with like-minded parties to bring about a constitutional amendment in Parliament, along with pursuing legal action in the Supreme Court for the necessary correction and initiating a legal battle on this front.

subsection.label: A
subsection.title: Protecting the financial and state rights of Tamil Nadu

points.title: Protecting Tamil Nadu's Rights in Constituency Delimitation
points.description: TVK strongly opposes delimitation of parliamentary constituencies based solely on population, as it would severely disadvantage southern states. Legal amendments will be pursued to prevent such injustice.

points.title: Opposition to 'One Nation, One Election'
points.description: TVK will resist the Union Government's plan for simultaneous elections, which undermines state autonomy and federal principles. Efforts will be made to withdraw this proposal.

points.title: Safeguarding Two-Language Policy
points.description: TVK will oppose the imposition of a three-language policy under the new education framework. A resolution will be passed in the Assembly, and a special inter-state committee will be formed to insist on the two-language policy (mother tongue + English) across India.

points.title: Abolition of NEET Exam
points.description: TVK will continue to press the Union Government to abolish the NEET exam, which has created barriers for Tamil Nadu students.

points.title: State Language in High Courts
points.description: TVK will demand that High Courts use the respective state languages as the language of proceedings.

points.title: Supreme Court Bench in Chennai
points.description: TVK will insist on establishing a Supreme Court bench in Chennai to ensure accessibility for Tamil Nadu citizens.

subsection.label: A
subsection.title: Protecting the financial and state rights of Tamil Nadu

points.title: Cauvery River Water Rights
points.description: Based on the 2018 Supreme Court verdict, TVK will ensure Tamil Nadu receives its rightful share of Cauvery water. Legal action will be taken against any obstruction, and strict monitoring will guarantee not a single drop is lost.

points.title: Katchatheevu Fishing Rights
points.description: TVK will press the Union Government to restore Tamil Nadu fishermen’s traditional fishing rights in the Gulf of Mannar, as per the Katchatheevu agreement. Strong measures will be taken to prevent arrests by the Sri Lankan Navy.

points.title: Justice for Sri Lankan Tamils
points.description: TVK will demand Indian citizenship for Sri Lankan Tamils living in Tamil Nadu, ensuring access to welfare schemes. It will also press the Union Government to protect the rights, culture, and properties of Tamils in Sri Lanka, and to eliminate ethnic discrimination.

points.title: Abolition of Governor Post
points.description: TVK will advocate for abolishing the colonial-era Governor post. Vice-Chancellor appointments will be made directly by the state government.

points.title: Cultural Heritage Report
points.description: ₹500 crore will be allocated to restore Tamil cultural sites and revive traditional arts such as Silambam, Kolattam, and Tanjore painting. International exhibitions will showcase Tamil heritage globally.

points.title: Archaeological Excavations
points.description: Continuous excavations will be supported at 10 sites including Keezhadi, Adichanallur, and Poompuhar. UNESCO heritage recognition will be sought for Keezhadi and Adichanallur. Student tours will be organized to these sites.

points.title: Tamil Civilization Museum in Madurai
points.description: An international-standard museum will be established in Madurai to highlight thousands of years of Tamil history.

points.title: Folk Artists Welfare
points.description: Registered folk artists will be guaranteed 100 days of employment annually through government events, plus ₹15,000 assistance for equipment purchases.

points.title: Folk Art Research and Training Centers
points.description: Centers will be established in Coimbatore, Thanjavur, and Tirunelveli to provide free training in folk arts like Karagattam, Bharatanatyam, and Silambam.

points.title: Traditional Sports Development
points.description: Support for Jallikattu, Rekla races, and Silambam competitions, including financial aid and international promotion.

points.title: Thirukkural Development Program
points.description: Students mastering 300–1330 couplets will receive scholarships, recognition, and cultural exposure. Thirukkural will be introduced as a special subject in schools.

points.title: Language Martyrs Pension
points.description: Families of language martyrs will receive ₹2.5 lakh annually. Competitions will be held to honor their sacrifice.

points.title: Tamil Artificial Intelligence
points.description: A Tamil AI model will be developed with universities, free for citizens, and licensed commercially abroad.

points.title: Digital Archives
points.description: Funds will be allocated to create digital archives preserving Tamil art, culture, and heritage.

points.title: Tamil Nadu Digital Museum
points.description: Tamil history and culture will be documented using AR, VR, and hologram technologies.

points.title: Responsible Tourism
points.description: Tourism revenue will be reinvested, with 25% allocated to local livelihoods.

points.title: Archaeological Tourism
points.description: Daily folk shows, village tourism centers, night markets, and cultural festivals will be organized.

points.title: Spiritual Tourism
points.description: Four major spiritual circuits will be developed, including Murugan temples, Shiva shrines, Vaishnavite holy sites, and interfaith pilgrimage routes.

points.title: Pilgrim Rest Houses
points.description: Rest houses will be built at major pilgrimage centers like Tiruvannamalai, Madurai, Rameswaram, and Velankanni.

points.title: Cultural Tourism
points.description: AR/VR experiences will recreate Tamil civilization at heritage sites like Keezhadi and Adichanallur.

points.title: Heritage Lodges
points.description: Tax incentives and subsidies will support restoration of Chettinad houses and Nilgiri bungalows as cultural lodges.

points.title: Marine Tourism
points.description: A coastal tourism route will be developed from Vedaranyam to Rameswaram, with fishermen as guides. Boat services to Sri Lanka will be explored.

points.title: Nilgiri Adventure Tourism
points.description: Mountain biking festivals, paragliding sites, and kayaking facilities will be introduced in Nilgiris.

points.title: Caravan Tourism
points.description: Caravan parks with amenities will be set up across 20 tourism zones, with subsidies for entrepreneurs.

points.title: Food Tourism
points.description: Chettinad, Kongu, and Tirunelveli food circuits will be developed, with international food festivals.

points.title: River Tourism
points.description: Tourism routes will be created along Cauvery, Vaigai, and Tamiraparani rivers.

points.title: Tourism Skill Development
points.description: 12-week training programs will cover hospitality, food preparation, guiding, and water safety.

points.title: Cinema Tourism
points.description: Film shooting locations will be promoted with QR codes linking movies to sites.

points.title: Tourist Safety
points.description: Infrastructure, tourist police, lifeguards, and 24/7 help centers will be established.

points.title: Poverty-Free Tamil Nadu
points.description: All poor families will be identified and provided welfare schemes and employment opportunities.

points.title: Free Electricity
points.description: 200 units of free electricity per month for eligible households.

points.title: Drinking Water for All
points.description: 100% clean drinking water supply to all households.

points.title: Housing for All
points.description: 5 lakh houses will be built for rural poor.

points.title: Patta Regularization
points.description: Patta documents will be digitized and regularized for residents in government lands.

points.title: Public Distribution System Reform
points.description: Doorstep ration delivery for elderly and disabled, fortified foods, packaged supplies, strict quality checks, more ration shops, and gender-specific staff appointments.

points.title: Social Justice Budget
points.description: Funds allocated for SC/ST welfare will be used exclusively for their development.

points.title: Scholarship
points.description: ₹40,000 annual scholarship for SC/ST students in professional courses.

points.title: Entrepreneurship Grant
points.description: ₹5 lakh investment support for first-generation SC/ST entrepreneurs.

points.title: Loan Waiver
points.description: Loans taken from Tamil Nadu Adi Dravidar Housing and Development Corporation will be waived.

points.title: Housing and Patta
points.description: Permanent housing and patta for all SC/ST families.

points.title: Atrocity Prevention
points.description: Special police units in each district to prevent atrocities against SC/ST communities.

points.title: Implement Sachar Committee Recommendations
points.description: TVK will press the Union Government to implement Sachar Committee recommendations for minority welfare.

points.title: Education and Entrepreneurship
points.description: Skill centers in each district; colleges for minority women; simplified funding for education and businesses.

points.title: Protect Minority Institutions
points.description: Legal and policy measures to safeguard minority-run educational and medical institutions.

points.title: Oppose Waqf Amendment
points.description: Legal battle in Supreme Court against new Waqf amendment.

points.title: Pilgrimage Subsidies
points.description: Enhanced subsidies for Haj, Jerusalem, and other pilgrimages.

points.title: Burial Grounds
points.description: Adequate land allocation for minority burial grounds and cemeteries.

points.title: Pension
points.description: Monthly pension raised to ₹3000.

points.title: Free Pilgrimage
points.description: Annual free pilgrimage for 2.5 lakh senior citizens with AC travel, lodging, and food.

points.title: Mobile Clinics
points.description: 1000 mobile clinics with doctors, nurses, physiotherapists for free checkups and medicines.

points.title: Equipment Subsidy
points.description: ₹10,000 subsidy for walking sticks, glasses, wheelchairs, hearing aids, dentures.

points.title: Senior Homes
points.description: Homes with medical staff and recreation facilities in each district.

points.title: Recreation Centers
points.description: Centers with libraries, yoga, meditation, and indoor games.

points.title: Pension
points.description: Monthly pension raised to ₹3000.

points.title: Special Education
points.description: Special teachers in every government school; dedicated schools for special children.

points.title: Assistive Devices
points.description: Subsidy for wheelchairs, glasses, hearing aids, walking aids.

points.title: Reservation
points.description: Strict enforcement of 4% reservation for disabled persons.

points.title: Transgender Welfare Law
points.description: ₹3000 monthly pension, skill training, self-help groups, and self-employment support.

points.title: Annual Aid
points.description: ₹30,000 annual aid per weaving family.

points.title: Raw Material Subsidy
points.description: 50% subsidy for yarn, dyes, chemicals.

points.title: Free Electricity
points.description: 500 units free for handloom households; 1500 units for powerloom households; 75% subsidy for solar panels.

points.title: Life Insurance
points.description: ₹10 lakh life insurance for all weavers.

points.title: Savings Scheme
points.description: Government contribution to cooperative savings scheme raised from 8% to 16%.

points.title: Integrated Weaver Towns
points.description: Special towns with solar panels in Kanchipuram, Arani, Salem, and Erode.

points.title: Scholarships
points.description: Scholarships for weaver children in design and textile engineering.

points.title: ‘Vettri Thari’ Brand

points.title: Solar Panel Subsidy
points.description: 100% subsidy for solar panels in weaving sheds.

points.description: Restoration of old pension scheme.

points.title: 8th Pay Commission

points.title: Old Pension Scheme
points.description: Restoration of the old pension scheme, replacing the contributory pension system.

points.title: Government Employees Welfare Board
points.description: A welfare board with ₹5000 crore allocation will be established to safeguard rights and benefits of government employees, police, and teachers.

points.title: Regularization of Temporary Staff
points.description: Temporary employees such as teachers and nurses will be regularized after 5 years of service.

points.title: Transparent Promotions and Transfers
points.description: Promotions and transfers will be conducted fairly and transparently.

points.title: 8th Pay Commission
points.description: Immediate implementation of the 8th Pay Commission recommendations once announced by the Union Government.

points.title: Police Welfare Scheme
points.description: Weekly offs, laundry allowance increased to ₹1000, and police welfare hospitals in major districts.

points.title: Police Honorarium
points.description: Families of police officers who die in duty will receive ₹1 crore honorarium.

points.title: Police Salary and Allowances
points.description: Base salary raised to ₹25,000; ₹1000 monthly duty allowance for high workload divisions.

points.title: Transparent Police Administration
points.description: Transfers and postings will be free of political interference, based only on merit and need.

points.title: Abolition of Orderly System
points.description: VIPs will no longer misuse police personnel as orderlies.

points.title: Police Quarters
points.description: Adequate housing quarters for police families in all districts.

points.title: Women Police Welfare
points.description: Women police will be appointed as frontline officers, not restricted to bandobust duties.

points.title: Equal Pay for Teachers
points.description: Temporary teachers with 5 years service will be regularized and given equal pay as permanent teachers.

points.title: Foreign Training for Teachers
points.description: Selected government school teachers will be sent to Singapore and Finland for training annually.

points.title: Teacher Recruitment
points.description: All vacant posts in government schools will be filled.

points.title: AI Training for Teachers
points.description: AI and digital education skill development program for government school teachers.

points.title: Removal of Non-Teaching Duties
points.description: Teachers will no longer be assigned non-teaching tasks.

points.title: Salary Increase for Anganwadi & ASHA Workers
points.description: Anganwadi workers upgraded to Grade-D employees with ₹18,000 monthly salary; assistants and ASHA workers to receive ₹10,000 monthly.

points.title: Retirement Benefits
points.description: Anganwadi and ASHA workers completing 20 years of service will receive ₹15 lakh retirement benefit.

points.title: End Manual Scavenging
points.description: Manual scavenging will be eliminated; modern machines will be used. Strict legal action against violators.

points.title: Training for Sanitation Workers
points.description: Workers will be trained to operate modern machines and appointed as operators.

points.title: Pension Scheme
points.description: Retired sanitation workers will receive ₹4000 monthly pension.

points.title: Drivers Welfare Board
points.description: Registered auto/taxi drivers will be covered with ₹10 lakh life insurance and accident insurance.

points.title: Digital Permits
points.description: Vehicle permits, licenses, and insurance renewals will be fully digitized.

points.title: Tamil Taxi App
points.description: A commission-free Tamil Taxi app will be launched in major cities.

points.title: Green Motor Vehicle Scheme
points.description: 50% subsidy for new electric autos (up to ₹75,000) and CNG conversion (up to ₹30,000).

points.title: Best Driver Award
points.description: Annual Driver’s Day with awards and ₹50,000 cash prize for exemplary drivers.

points.title: Gig Workers Law
points.description: A Tamil Nadu Gig Workers Law will be enacted to ensure job security and social status for over 15 lakh gig workers.

points.title: Social Security for Gig Workers
points.description: Registered gig workers will receive ₹10 lakh life insurance and accident insurance.

points.title: Interest-Free Loans for E-Bikes
points.description: Gig workers in delivery services will receive interest-free loans to purchase e-bikes.

points.title: Street Vendors Welfare Law
points.description: Special zones for street vendors in municipalities; interest-free loans up to ₹50,000; relocation only with alternative sites provided.

points.title: Journalists Social Security
points.description: Accredited journalists will receive ₹15 lakh life insurance. Retired journalists with income below ₹5 lakh will receive ₹15,000 monthly pension. Local journalists will be accredited.

points.title: Lawyers Welfare Fund
points.description: Lawyers with less than ₹5 lakh annual income and 20 years of practice will receive ₹3000 monthly pension. All registered lawyers will get life insurance.

points.title: Legal Advisors Honorarium
points.description: Legal advisors providing free rural legal aid will receive ₹5000 monthly honorarium.

subsection.label: R & S
