points.title: Construction Workers Social Security
points.description: Registered construction workers will receive ₹5 lakh accident insurance.

points.title: Reform of Construction Workers Welfare Board
points.description: The welfare board will be restructured to function effectively.

points.title: Palm Tree Protection
points.description: Palm trees will be declared protected. A Palm Development Corporation with ₹200 crore funding will promote palm products and exports. Palm workers will receive ₹3000 monthly aid during off-seasons.

points.title: Salt Workers Monsoon Relief
points.description: Relief allowance for salt workers during monsoon will be increased to ₹7000.

points.title: Women Safety Division
points.description: A dedicated division under the Chief Minister’s supervision for women and girl child safety and welfare.

points.title: Valuable Women Scheme
points.description: ₹2500 monthly deposit into the bank account of every woman head of household until age 60.

points.title: Annapoorni Super Six
points.description: Direct cash transfer for six LPG cylinders annually per family.

points.title: Free Travel Scheme
points.description: Women will travel free in all government buses across Tamil Nadu.

points.title: Annan Seer Scheme
points.description: For marriages in families with annual income below ₹5 lakh, 8 grams of gold and a silk saree will be provided to the bride.

points.title: Thaimaman Gold Ring Scheme
points.description: Every child born in government hospitals will receive a gold ring and a kit with essentials.

points.title: Kamarajar Education Assurance Scheme
points.description: ₹15,000 annually in two installments to mothers/guardians of students from class 1 to 12 in government and aided schools.

points.title: Widows and Destitute Women Aid
points.description: ₹3000 monthly aid for widows and destitute women.

points.title: SHG Development Scheme
points.description: Women SHGs will receive interest-free loans up to ₹5 lakh, grants up to ₹5 lakh, and ₹1 lakh incentive for 5 years of continuous performance. Products will be marketed globally via e-commerce.

points.title: Women Maha Sakthi
points.description: 40% of government procurement will be sourced from women SHGs and enterprises.

points.title: Special Industrial Parks
points.description: Women-focused industrial parks will be established in 10 major cities including Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, and Tirunelveli.

points.title: Rani Velunachiyar Force
points.description: 500 all-women surveillance squads named after Rani Velunachiyar will be formed, equipped with body cameras.

points.title: AI Surveillance Centers
points.description: Smart panic buttons in buses and autos, AI-enabled CCTV in public places, and safety measures in vulnerable areas.

points.title: Fast-Track Courts for Women
points.description: Special fast-track courts will be set up to quickly deliver justice in crimes against women.

points.title: Hostels for Working Women and Students
points.description: Safe hostels with modern facilities in major cities, with maximum monthly rent capped at ₹2500.

points.title: Pregnant Women Assistance
points.description: ₹25,000 financial aid for nutrition, medical checkups, and essentials. 'Thai Care' centers will provide free food, medical help, and monitoring for pregnant women near delivery.

points.title: Free Sanitary Napkins
points.description: Sanitary napkins will be distributed free through ration shops, schools, and colleges. Vending machines will be installed in towns, and disposal facilities in government school toilets.

points.title: Free Cervical Cancer Screening and HPV Vaccination
points.description: Girls aged 9–14 will receive free HPV vaccines. Women above 30 will get free cervical cancer screening at primary health centers.

points.title: Solar Stoves for Tribal Women
points.description: Free solar stoves will be provided to tribal and hill women to reduce dependence on firewood.

points.title: Youth Success Fund
points.description: Unemployed graduates registered with employment offices will receive ₹4000 monthly; 12th pass/ITI/diploma holders will receive ₹2500 monthly for two years.

points.title: Transparency in Recruitment
points.description: A special law will ensure government recruitment is fair and transparent, with all processes completed within one year.

points.title: Filling Vacancies
points.description: All vacant government posts will be filled promptly.

points.title: Education Guarantee Scheme
points.description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh for students from UG to PhD, ensuring access to desired courses without financial barriers.

points.title: Skill Training and Internships
points.description: Internships with government and private firms for 5 lakh youth annually. Graduates will receive ₹10,000/month, vocational trainees ₹8000/month.

points.title: Youth Entrepreneurship Scheme
points.description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹25 lakh for youth entrepreneurs.

points.title: Local Employment Scheme
points.description: Private firms employing 75% Tamil Nadu youth will receive GST concessions, electricity subsidies, and procurement priority.

points.title: Chief Minister’s Public Service Friend Scheme
points.description: 5 lakh youth will be appointed in local bodies with ₹18,000 monthly salary to ensure government services reach every household.

points.title: Digital Creators Promotion Scheme
points.description: 1.5 lakh creators will receive funding for Tamil culture-based content. 500 training centers will provide video production and digital marketing skills.

points.title: Tamil Nadu Youth Advisory Council
points.description: A council will be formed to advise the Chief Minister and senior officials, ensuring youth participation in governance.

points.title: Micro Tech Parks
points.description: 25 cities will host micro tech parks with internet, co-working spaces, and consultancy halls, enabling youth to work globally from hometowns.

points.title: Tamil Nadu Sports University
points.description: A sports university will provide world-class training, medical support, and technology to athletes, with excellence centers across Tamil Nadu.

points.title: Tamil Nadu Olympic Success Scheme
points.description: Olympic-level training for identified athletes. ₹25 lakh aid for individual athletes, ₹10 lakh for teams. Cash prizes: ₹6 crore for gold, ₹4 crore for silver, ₹3 crore for bronze. 500 athletes will receive support for national/international competitions.

points.title: World-Class Sports Infrastructure
points.description: World-class multi-sport stadiums, sports complexes, gymkhanas, sports academies and training centres will be established in the 10 zonal headquarters of Tamil Nadu.

points.title: Young Athletes Identification Programme
points.description: 500 sporting talents aged 8 to 14 will be identified directly from schools based on their interest and skill, and given world-class training to help them compete and win at the Olympics.

points.title: Paralympics Talent Development Programme
points.description: Eligible Paralympic athletes will be identified and given world-class training and financial assistance. World-class Paralympics training centres will be set up in Madurai, Salem and Trichy.

points.title: Coastal Sports Development
points.description: 10 coastal sports centres for water sports such as surfing, kayaking, wind-surfing, snorkelling and scuba diving will be established across coastal Tamil Nadu, with training priority given to youth from fishing and coastal communities.

section.title: Victorious Tamil Nadu
section.subtitle: Welfare of Farmers, Agricultural Labourers and Fishermen

points.title: Farm Loan Waiver
points.description: Crop loans taken from cooperative banks will be fully waived for farmers owning less than 5 acres. Farmers owning more than 5 acres will get a 50% waiver on their crop loans from cooperative banks.

points.title: Vetri Farmer Entitlement Fund
points.description: Every farming family that owns agricultural land will receive Rs. 15,000 per year as seed-capital assistance, paid in two instalments (June-August and January-February), to help meet sowing-season expenses.

points.title: Cultivator Support Scheme
points.description: Tenant farmers and agricultural labourers will be issued farmer identity cards under a newly introduced system. Cardholders will receive Rs. 10,000 per year in direct assistance credited to their bank accounts.

points.title: Minimum Support Price for Paddy and Sugarcane
points.description: A minimum support price of Rs. 3,500 per quintal for paddy and Rs. 4,500 per tonne for sugarcane will be guaranteed. If market prices for turmeric, sugarcane, paddy and copra fall, the government will step in, and this MSP and market-loss compensation will be paid directly into farmers' bank accounts.

points.title: Farmers' Income Enhancement Commission
points.description: A Farmers' Income Enhancement Commission will be set up to recommend measures for raising farmer income, simplifying market access, and guiding price-fixing policy. It will submit recommendations to the government every year.

points.title: 100% Free Crop Insurance
points.description: Agro-meteorological centres will be established across Tamil Nadu to accurately assess crop losses due to weather in each locality. Compensation will be paid promptly based on this data, and 100% of cultivated land will be brought under crop insurance.

points.title: Copra and Coconut Farmers' Welfare
points.description: To protect coconut farmers from price fluctuations, a copra support fund will be created. Coconut producers in Coimbatore, Thanjavur, Pollachi and Kangeyam will have their copra procured through cooperative societies, processed into oil at government mills, and sold via public distribution. An MSP for copra will be introduced, price-fall protection extended to milling and milk-grade coconut varieties, and fair farmer income assured. A 'Tamil Nadu Coconut Processing Corporation' will be set up to create value-added coconut and coconut-oil products and raise farmer income.

points.title: Tamil Nadu Organic Farming Scheme
points.description: Steps to make Tamil Nadu a leading state in organic farming include: monthly assistance of Rs. 2,000 for three years to farmers transitioning from chemical to organic farming; a new certified brand, 'Tamil Iyal', for organically grown traditional rice varieties, spices, coconut, turmeric and banana, based on trust marks; and a Nammazhwar Organic Agricultural College to be established in Thanjavur.

points.title: Farmer Producer Organisation Support
points.description: An incentive of Rs. 5,000 will be given to farmers who join Farmer Producer Organisations.

points.title: Free Higher Education for Farmers' Children
points.description: Farmers who own less than 2 acres of agricultural land will receive free higher education for their children, without any fees.

points.title: Reducing Wastage at Procurement Centres
points.description: Paddy and other produce such as vegetables, food grains and minor produce will be scientifically protected across all procurement centres, cluster hubs and silos, reducing post-harvest losses. Weighing and storage will be scientifically managed. Farmers will not be forced to buy gunny bags or hire loading/tractor services on payment at procurement centres, and strict action will be taken against such practices regardless of who is responsible.

points.title: Fishermen Protection Entitlement Fund
points.description: Compensation during the fishing ban period will be raised to Rs. 20,000. Fishermen practising traditional fishing methods will receive Rs. 7,000 as north-east monsoon compensation.

points.title: Fishermen Accident Insurance
points.description: Every registered fisherman will receive accident insurance cover worth Rs. 25 lakh. Sea rescue ambulances equipped with modern technology will be stationed at every major fishing harbour to assist fishermen in distress at sea, along with rescue-vessel facilities to tow back disabled boats.

points.title: Fishermen's Fuel Subsidy
points.description: The diesel subsidy quota for fishing boats will be raised from 1,800 litres to 3,600 litres, with an additional subsidy of Rs. 15 per litre credited directly to the boat owner's bank account.

points.title: Minimum Support Price for Fish
points.description: India's first minimum support price for fish species such as prawns, mathi (sardine), anchovy and squid will be introduced, to protect fishermen from price crashes when catches are abundant, with shortfall compensation credited directly to fishermen's bank accounts.

points.title: Kadaltha Veedu (Sea-side Housing Scheme)
points.description: A coastal housing scheme will be introduced to ensure slum-free coastal settlements, with houses built to withstand cyclones, sea erosion and adverse weather. Priority will be given to fishing communities in cyclone-prone Nagapattinam, Cuddalore, Ramanathapuram, Thoothukudi and Kanniyakumari districts.

points.title: Welfare for Families of Missing Fishermen
points.description: Under current rules, a fisherman missing at sea is officially declared dead only after 7 years, after which the family becomes eligible for compensation. This will be changed so that if a fisherman goes missing at sea, the family becomes eligible for due compensation after 6 months.

points.title: Fishermen Entrepreneur Welfare Scheme
points.description: Coastal youth interested in becoming entrepreneurs in high-value sea-related businesses such as boat repair yards, ice factories, cold storage, fish marketing and seaweed production will receive a startup incentive grant of Rs. 5 lakh.

points.title: Welfare for Inland Water-Body Fishermen
points.description: Fishermen who fish in rivers, tanks, ponds and reservoirs currently receive no benefits from the Tamil Nadu Fishermen Welfare Board. This will be changed so that all fishermen, regardless of where they fish, become eligible for all benefits of the Board. Eligible prawn farmers will also receive benefits, including insurance protection against losses from unexpected disease outbreaks.

points.title: Seafood Retail Outlets
points.description: Just as Aavin operates milk product retail outlets, dedicated seafood retail outlets will be established across Tamil Nadu to improve fishermen's livelihoods, selling value-added, canned and tinned seafood products.

points.title: Seaweed Park
points.description: A seaweed-processing industrial park will be set up at Rameswaram, where seaweed will be converted into food, medicinal and cosmetic products, with priority given to women's self-help groups.

points.title: Coastal Protection Scheme
points.description: Coastal protection barriers will be built along more than 200 km of coastline in districts most affected by sea erosion, namely Nagapattinam, Cuddalore, Viluppuram, Ramanathapuram and Kanniyakumari.

points.title: Fishing Harbour Modernisation
points.description: Cold-storage sheds, hazard-free waste-disposal facilities, Bio Floc Technology and cage-fish-farming infrastructure will be set up at fishing harbours across Tamil Nadu. A direct trading chain between fishermen and fish traders, free of middlemen, will be established, and modern landing centres and fish-processing facilities will be created at every fishing harbour.

points.title: Deep-Sea Fishing Boats Fund
points.description: Interest-free loans will be provided to fishermen to purchase deep-sea fishing boats equipped with modern navigation and safety facilities.

points.title: River Interlinking
points.description: The Cauvery-Vaigai-Gundar, Then Pennaiyar-Palar, Pennaiyar-Cheyyar and Tamiraparani-Vaippar river interlinking projects, all previously announced but never fully implemented, will be completed on a fast-track basis with Rs. 5,000 crore allocated for the work.

points.title: Water Storage Scheme
points.description: Over 39,000 irrigation tanks across Tamil Nadu currently lack proper maintenance and are in poor condition. All of them will be systematically restored under this water-storage scheme, creating 5 lakh new agricultural ponds in the process.

points.title: Achieving 100% Irrigated Cultivation
points.description: TVK aims to convert rain-fed single-crop lands into fully irrigated farmland, achieving 100% irrigation coverage across Tamil Nadu. A special mission will be launched to realise this long-term goal, ensure water security, reduce farming risk, and substantially raise farmer incomes.

points.title: Drip and Micro-Sprinkler Irrigation Scheme
points.description: The current subsidy of 75% for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems for small and marginal farmers will be raised to 90%. This will cut water use for irrigation by 40%, expand drip-irrigated area by 30 lakh acres, and raise crop yields.

points.title: Fast-Tracking Irrigation Projects
points.description: To ensure water security, groundwater recharge and flood control across Tamil Nadu, a special mission-mode programme will accelerate zone-wise water infrastructure projects, including the following key initiatives:

points.title: Fast-Tracking Irrigation Projects (project list, continued from point 5)
points.description: Priority projects include the Tirupur-Coimbatore drinking water scheme, the Ethalanoothu-Pulicherai interlinking project (Dharmapuri), construction of check dams and bridges on the Cauvery and Thirumanimuthar in Namakkal district, the Mel Vaippar and Mudukulathur river-restoration project (Virudhunagar/Rajapalayam), the Ramanadhi-Jambunathi canal interlinking project (Thenkasi/Alanganallur), and the Tamiraparani-Karumeniyaru-Nambiyaru interlinking project (Tirunelveli/Thoothukudi), among other major schemes across the state.

points.title: Copra and Coconut Farmers' Welfare - Solar Pump Conversion
points.description: Within the next 5 years, diesel and electric pump sets used by coconut farmers will be converted to solar pump sets, and the resulting savings in power costs will be passed on as income to the farmers who own them.

points.title: Farmer Artificial Intelligence Micro-Advisory Scheme
points.description: Each farmer will receive AI-based advisory information on their own smartphone covering land condition, pest control needs, fertiliser deficiencies, ideal sowing dates and harvesting guidance, allowing every farmer to know their land's real-time condition through their smart phone. Cooperative societies will provide drones to farming communities at subsidised rates for pest control and fertiliser spraying.

points.title: Agri-Business Protection Hubs
points.description: Agri-business protection hubs will be set up in Coimbatore, Madurai and Trichy, among other locations, to launch agri start-up companies. Entrepreneurs starting agri-business ventures will receive a seed grant of Rs. 10 lakh, boosting small-scale food processing and packaging businesses that use drones for pest control and produce cleaning.

points.title: Value Addition Centres for Turmeric, Mango and Copra
points.description: Erode turmeric, Krishnagiri mango and copra produced in the Kongu region will fetch higher prices through dedicated value-addition measures.
sub_points: An Erode turmeric grading park will be established to separate the higher grades of turmeric used in pharmaceuticals from ordinary turmeric, so farmers can sell each grade separately at a fair price instead of a single uniform price.

points.title: Value Addition Centres for Turmeric, Mango and Copra (continued)
sub_points: Krishnagiri mangoes will be transported directly to Chennai and Bengaluru airports with dedicated logistics support for export, protecting mango growers from local market price crashes caused by oversupply.
A coconut and coconut-product value-addition centre will be established for the Kongu region.

points.title: Cauvery Delta Ecosystem Restoration
points.description: The Cauvery Delta is the heart of Tamil Nadu's agriculture, but its water resources, land quality and farm productivity face serious threats from environmental degradation. Key measures to address this include: Rs. 5,000 crore allocated to restore groundwater levels and address declining groundwater and soil quality in the Delta; targeted action to reverse falling groundwater levels and improve soil health; and a dedicated Agricultural Ecology Centre established to study environmental and chemical impacts on the Delta and implement corrective measures.

points.title: Coastal Green Belt Project
points.description: Solar-powered 'Green Belt Gardens' will be established in the coastal districts of Ramanathapuram, Nagapattinam and Thoothukudi to reduce soil salinity along the coast, benefiting crops such as chilli and jasmine.

points.title: Delta Biochar Purification Centre
points.description: Straw left over after every paddy harvest across Tamil Nadu is currently mostly wasted or burnt in the field. A scheme will convert this straw into biochar. 10 biochar purification centres will be set up in Thanjavur and Tiruvarur districts, producing ethanol and biochar and generating additional income for paddy farmers. These facilities will be run by local farmer groups.

points.title: Drought Zones
points.description: Ramanathapuram and Virudhunagar districts will be declared drought zones. Incentive support will be given to farmers in these zones who grow millets and oilseeds using drip and sprinkler irrigation to conserve limited water resources.

points.title: Cold-Storage Warehouses
points.description: Standardised cold-storage warehouses will be established to prevent post-harvest wastage of agricultural produce. Measures for proper protective packaging will also be implemented to safeguard produce vulnerable to rain and heat.

points.title: Free Milch Cows and Goats
points.description: To improve the livelihoods of 2 lakh families, milch cows and goats will be provided to them free of cost.

points.title: Milk Procurement Price Increase
points.description: The procurement price Aavin pays milk producers for their milk will be raised to Rs. 44 per litre.

points.title: A2 Milk Promotion Scheme
points.description: Measures will be implemented to increase production of A2-grade milk, available only from native Indian cattle breeds, and to boost production and standardised marketing of A2 ghee, butter, milk cake and ice cream made from it.

points.title: Livestock Insurance
points.description: Below-poverty-line families rearing livestock will be given free comprehensive livestock insurance without any premium charge, along with incentive assistance for these families.

points.title: Restoration of Traditional Cattle Breeds
points.description: To restore Tamil Nadu's traditional cattle breeds such as Kangayam, Pulikulam, Umblachery, Bargur and Alambadi, women self-help groups rearing them will receive an incentive of Rs. 5,000 per breed. Livestock banks will be set up to help these self-help groups sell livestock-related products to farmers at fair prices.

points.title: Livestock Feed Bank
points.description: Feed banks to stock and sell livestock feed, along with cold-storage facilities for milk preservation, will be set up on a large scale in every village panchayat.

points.title: Veterinary Healthcare Centres
points.description: Adequately staffed veterinary hospitals will be established across Tamil Nadu, along with multi-specialty veterinary hospitals in urban districts.

points.title: Modernisation of Government Schools
points.description: Every government school in Tamil Nadu will be equipped with world-class science and research labs, high-speed internet-enabled computer labs with digital libraries, STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Maths) training centres, modern toilets, clean drinking water facilities, standard reading rooms, counselling centres, and other such facilities. By 2031, all government school classrooms in Tamil Nadu will be converted into smart classrooms.

points.title: Making Tamil Nadu #1 in Learning Outcomes
points.description: Special targeted schemes will be implemented in mission mode to address gender- and social-background-based gaps in students' learning skills, aiming to make Tamil Nadu the top-ranked state in the country for learning outcomes, on par with the most developed nations.

points.title: Kamarajar Special Schools
points.description: 100 exclusive high-quality schools will be opened across Tamil Nadu for meritorious students from socially and economically disadvantaged families. These schools will provide free education, food, accommodation, uniforms and other facilities for students from class 6 to 12. Of these 100 schools, 50 will be reserved exclusively for girl students.

points.title: Zero Dropout
points.description: To curb the rising rate of school dropouts, AI-supported technology-based monitoring systems will be set up across Tamil Nadu. 1,000 education coordinators will be appointed to identify students who left school due to social or economic reasons and help re-enrol them.

points.title: Expansion of the Breakfast Scheme
points.description: The Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme will be expanded to cover students up to class 8 in government schools and government-aided schools, with enhanced nutritional standards, ensuring that all students receive a balanced meal.

points.title: 10% Increase in Reservation
points.description: Reservation for rural government school students in professional undergraduate admissions will be raised from 7.5% to 10%. In addition, a 10% reservation will be provided for government school students in postgraduate admissions.

points.title: Headmaster Skill Development Programme
points.description: A headmaster skill development programme will be implemented to continuously strengthen the leadership qualities of school headmasters, supported by a dedicated leadership training institute offering ongoing training to all serving headmasters statewide. Schools that excel in learning outcomes under this programme will receive an incentive of Rs. 50 lakh.

points.title: Tamil Nadu Student Entrepreneur Scheme
points.description: To encourage entrepreneurship among students during their school years, students in classes 11 and 12 in government schools will be given seed capital of Rs. 5,100 to help create small-scale business models. In addition, all schools will introduce special entrepreneurship classes as extracurricular activities beyond the regular curriculum.

points.title: Student Mental Health Protection
points.description: To safeguard the mental health and wellbeing of government school students and teachers, 5,000 mental health counsellors will be appointed to provide psychological first-response training. A curriculum will also be introduced among students to reduce mental stress and build resilience and happiness.

points.title: AI in the School Curriculum
points.description: To transform Tamil Nadu government school students into forward-looking leaders, AI literacy will be taught as part of the curriculum from class 6 to 12. Students will also be taught time-management and adaptability skills to help them respond responsibly to changing times, as part of the curriculum from class 6 to 12.

points.title: New Government Professional Colleges
points.description: Five new government engineering colleges and three new government medical colleges will be started in districts that currently lack them. Central government approval will be actively pursued for the medical college permissions. 30 government arts and science colleges will be upgraded to autonomous college status.

points.title: Education Life Fund
points.description: Every government school student who joins a government college after completing school will receive Rs. 8,000 to help reduce the financial burden of college admission expenses.

points.title: Highest Respect for Knowledge Seekers
points.description: The Tamil Nadu government will formally recognise the educational and life achievements of Tamil students who qualify to study at the world's top 100 educational institutions. In turn, these students will serve for three years after graduation as government advisors, honorary faculty at Tamil Nadu educational institutions, or as entrepreneurs setting up businesses in Tamil Nadu, using their knowledge and experience to guide the next generation of students.

points.title: Free College Fees for First-Generation Graduates
points.description: College fees will be fully waived for first-generation graduate students from Adi Dravidar and tribal communities and from economically disadvantaged families who studied in government schools and go on to join government colleges.

points.title: Dedicated University for Emerging Technologies
points.description: A Periyar Institute of Emerging Technologies (PIET) will be established, offering degree programmes in emerging fields such as artificial intelligence, quantum computing, biotechnology, climate technology, space technology and cybersecurity.

points.title: Dedicated University for Emerging Technologies (continued)
points.description: This university will operate in partnership with leading global universities and technology companies for degree programmes in these emerging fields.

points.title: ITI Modernisation
points.description: All Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across Tamil Nadu will be modernised, with new curriculum modules added in Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). New ITIs will be opened based on student demand.

points.title: Skill Training Centres for Emerging Technologies
points.description: Skill training centres will be set up in every district of Tamil Nadu, offering free six-month certificate courses in artificial intelligence, EV technology, animation, cloud computing, cyber security and related fields, in partnership with Tamil Nadu's leading companies to help ensure certificate-holders find employment.

points.title: Free Training for Competitive Examinations
points.description: Special initiatives will be undertaken to help rural youth excel in competitive examinations, modernised district libraries will house upgraded training centres for competitive exams, and each young person's learning ability will be assessed through artificial intelligence to provide personalised guidance.

subsection.label: A
subsection.title: Industrial Growth - A Golden Decade for Tamil Nadu's Economy

points.title: $1.5 Trillion Economy
points.description: Necessary groundwork will be undertaken to raise Tamil Nadu's economy to US$1.5 trillion by 2036, ensuring the state achieves a decade of growth unprecedented in its history.

points.title: Top 20 Plan
points.description: 20 sectors with strong future growth potential in the industrial revolution will be identified, and dedicated Industry Transformation Maps will be prepared for each. Industrial development centres will be set up statewide to support government-private partnership in implementing these plans.

points.title: Globalising Tamil Nadu's Industries
points.description: Products made in Tamil Nadu - textiles from Tirupur, leather goods from Vellore, footwear made in Chennai, jewellery from Erode - have strong global demand. An 'EnterpriseTNPlan' will be introduced to market all Tamil Nadu-made products globally, attract foreign investment, sign agreements with international companies for exporting Tamil Nadu-made goods, and create dedicated export sections in every SIPCOT industrial estate in the state.

points.title: SIPCOT and Industrial Estate Renovation, Modernisation and Land Use
points.description: To simplify doing business and improve approval efficiency, the TVK government will comprehensively modernise all SIPCOT industrial estates across Tamil Nadu.

points.title: SIPCOT and Industrial Estate Renovation (continued)
points.description: This will ensure uninterrupted power supply, adequate drinking water, and strong road infrastructure connecting industrial estates to cities and ports. New SIPCOT parks will be created in backward districts, while farmland will not be acquired for these parks. All vacant SIPCOT land will be prioritised for production and commercial use, with penalties for delayed utilisation to ensure land is fully and productively used.

points.title: Guarantee Loan Scheme - Rs. 15,000 Crore Fund
points.description: Small and medium-scale industries in Tamil Nadu face challenges from rising power tariffs, inadequate distribution facilities and financial pressure. To address this, a state fund of Rs. 15,000 crore will be allocated to provide loans to distressed small and medium enterprises at 4% interest.

points.title: Power Tariff Assurance Scheme
points.description: Fixed charges and peak-hour power charges for MSMEs will be frozen with immediate effect. After a comprehensive review, power tariffs will be rationalised. Under the 'Vetri Solar Mission', MSME establishments that install rooftop solar power systems will receive 100% power tax exemption for five years.

points.title: Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme
points.description: Tamil Nadu's growing MSMEs are unable to acquire globally competitive technologies, particularly lacking funds for AI, sensor technology and modern production equipment, which affects their competitiveness in global markets. To address this, MSMEs will receive a capital subsidy of up to Rs. 50 lakh, or a higher percentage of investment as applicable, to purchase new technologies. Rs. 1,000 crore will be allocated for this Technology Upgradation Fund.

points.title: Priority for Tamil Nadu Companies
points.description: 40% of government procurement of goods from small and medium enterprises will be reserved for companies based in Tamil Nadu. A Tamil Nadu Supplier Register will be created to register Tamil Nadu-based MSMEs, making them easily identifiable and giving them procurement priority.

points.title: Right to Approval Within 21 Days
points.description: To promote industrial growth, procedures for starting a new industry will be simplified as follows: small and cottage industries will get approval rights within 7 working days; small and medium industries within 15 working days; and mega industries investing over Rs. 200 crore within 21 working days.

points.title: Right to Approval Within 21 Days (continued)
points.description: If the government fails to decide within the specified timeframes above, the applicant company will be deemed to have received automatic (deemed) approval.

points.title: Investor Promotion Commission
points.description: To ensure increased foreign direct investment in Tamil Nadu, an Investor Promotion Commission will be established under the Chief Secretary of the Tamil Nadu government, with the Industries Department Secretary serving as coordinator. Companies investing over Rs. 200 crore, or providing employment to 5,000 people, will receive approval within 15 working days through this commission. The Tamil Nadu government will also ensure power subsidies, investment subsidies and all other subsidies for industrial investors are disbursed without delay, in a timely manner.

points.title: Overseas Tamils Investment Scheme
points.description: To engage overseas Tamils and encourage their investment in Tamil Nadu, the following steps will be taken:
sub_points: World Tamil Welfare and Investment Commission: brought directly under the Chief Minister's supervision, to provide welfare assistance and expedite investment opportunities for overseas Tamils.
Overseas Tamil Investors Conference: an annual conference will be held for overseas Tamils to invest in Tamil Nadu's start-up companies, infrastructure and industries.

Overseas Tamil Welfare Wings: to be established in Dubai, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, London, Toronto, New York, Sydney, Brampton, Paris, Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, Riyadh, Jeddah, Washington, Chicago, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Johannesburg and Auckland.
Investing in Your Hometown: TIDCO NRI Liaison Officers will be appointed in 38 districts to help overseas Tamils invest in their home districts.

Overseas Tamil Property Protection Tribunal: a dedicated tribunal will be established to quickly resolve legal disputes over encroachment on properties and assets owned by overseas Tamils in Tamil Nadu, aiming to settle such disputes within six months.

points.title: AI Economy Plan
points.description: By 2035, AI technology is projected to add US$1.7 trillion to India's economy. Tamil Nadu will implement an AI industry development plan to benefit from this, with key initiatives including: training 5 lakh youth in AI through Polytechnics, ITIs and engineering colleges across Tamil Nadu by 2031; establishing AI Centres of Excellence in 5 sectors - healthcare, agriculture, manufacturing, Tamil language and climate; and a Tamil Nadu AI Investment Plan targeting Rs. 35,000 crore in investment across AI, deep-tech and GCC sectors by 2031.

points.title: India's First AI Ministry
points.description: India's first AI Ministry will be established, with a Chief AI Officer appointed in every government department under it. This ministry will lead pre-emptive initiatives to drive the AI industry.

points.title: Free AI Services for Tamil Nadu Entrepreneurs
points.description: India's first government-owned Ultra-High-Performance GPU Compute Cluster will be established, which start-ups and MSMEs in Tamil Nadu can use free of cost for AI services.

points.title: Arivagam AI City
points.description: India's first dedicated city built exclusively for artificial intelligence, named 'Arivagam' (Knowledge City), will be established, housing an AI university, an international skill centre, a semiconductor hardware testing lab and modern residential facilities.

points.title: Backward District Development Budget
points.description: A balanced development budget will be introduced to bridge the gap between developed and backward districts, announcing development projects specifically for Tamil Nadu's 12 backward districts.

points.title: District Special Industrial Development Scheme
points.description: A district-specific industrial development plan will be implemented across all 38 districts with ₹23,000 crore spent over 5 years. Global Investors Meets will be rotated in key cities like Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy, and Salem outside Chennai.

points.title: Western Region (Coimbatore, Tiruppur, Erode, Salem, Namakkal, Karur, Dharmapuri, Krishnagiri)
points.description: Textile Technology Center in Tiruppur with ₹2,000 crore infrastructure setup; Robotic Machine Centers in Coimbatore worth ₹1,000 crore for MSMEs.

points.title: Western Region Initiatives (Continued)
points.description: EV Bus Body Building Workshops in Karur and Namakkal (₹300 crore); Erode Jewelry and Digital Textile Hub; Salem Special Materials Valley for aerospace, medical, and defense steel components (₹500 crore); Dharmapuri - Krishnagiri Mango Industrial Corridor with 5 processing parks; Hosur - Krishnagiri Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Zone; Pollachi Coconut Industrial Estate.

points.title: Kurinji Region: Nilgiris - Kodaikanal (Dindigul)
points.description: 'Nilgiris Premium' tea brand created with ₹200 crore investment and 50 tea estate tour route; Food processing parks to export Kodaikanal homemade chocolates, Nilgiri cheese, and mountain honey to Singapore, Arab nations, and Europe; Tribal Eco-Tourism Board for tribal-managed homestays.

points.title: Kurinji Region Initiatives (Continued)
points.description: Agricultural Technology Research Station in Nilgiris at a cost of ₹150 crore.

points.title: Northern Region (Vellore, Ranipet, Tirupathur, Tiruvannamalai, Cuddalore, Villupuram, Kallakurichi, Chengalpattu, Tiruvallur, Kanchipuram, Chennai)
points.description: Leather Industry Development Scheme for Tirupathur-Vellore-Ranipet (₹500 crore); Chennai-Hosur EV Auto Spare Parts Manufacturing Support (₹1,500 crore); Defense Equipment Manufacturing Guidance for DRDO/HAL; Sriperumbudur-Oragadam Electronic Components Park (₹500 crore); Vallam Vadagal Aerospace Park Upgrade; Kanchipuram Silk Tourism & E-Commerce Platform; Tiruvannamalai Handloom Weaver Support.

points.title: Northern Region Initiatives (Continued)
points.description: Cuddalore SIPCOT Cleanup (₹500 crore); Villupuram-Cuddalore Biofuel and Ethanol Units; Maraimalai Nagar SIPCOT Expansion with EV Battery Testing & Certification Labs; Siruseri SIPCOT IT Park transformation into Fintech & AI Hub; Green Steel Production Support in Tiruvallur (₹300 crore); Mappedu SIPCOT Expansion for Motor-Electronics Components; Kallakurichi Sugar & Ethanol Modernization and New SIDCO/SIPCOT Estate.

points.title: Central Region (Trichy, Thanjavur, Pudukkottai, Nagapattinam, Mayiladuthurai, Dindigul, Ariyalur, Perambalur, Tiruvarur)
points.description: Aerospace and Heavy Engineering Zone with 10-year tax exemption and 300-acre Aerospace Fabrication Park near Trichy Airport.

points.title: Central Region Initiatives (Continued)
points.description: Thanjavur Agro-Processing Zone; Pudukkottai-Perambalur Granite Design & Polishing Center; Trichy-Thanjavur Medical Technology Park (₹300 crore); Ariyalur Construction Material Export Hub with rail facilities; Perambalur Modern Agro-Processing Centers; Mannargudi Fisheries & Aquaculture Export Center; Tiruvarur Cauvery Agro-Processing Center; Nagapattinam-Mayiladuthurai Integrated Modern Fish Export Centers.

points.title: Southern Region (Madurai, Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli, Virudhunagar, Kanyakumari, Ramanathapuram, Sivagangai, Tenkasi, Theni, Dindigul)
points.description: Southern Region Industrial Renaissance Act: Nanguneri SEZ turned into Free Trade Warehousing Zone; Madurai-Thoothukudi Rail/Industrial Corridor completion team; Kulasekarapattinam Space Industrial Park Expansion (2000 acres, 10-year tax exemption); Thoothukudi Port Renewable Energy Projects; Madurai-Virudhunagar Textile Revival Scheme (₹400 crore); Kanyakumari-Rameshwaram Blue Economy Zone; Athangudi Tiles Export & MSME Regularization; Sivagangai Traditional Handloom Support; Dindigul Lock Manufacturers MSME Integration.

points.title: Start-Smart Tamil Nadu
points.description: Financial assistance up to ₹50 lakhs, training, mentorship, and business support for 10,000 startups over 5 years.

points.title: 5 International Standard Incubators
points.description: Incubators in Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy, and Salem offering free workspace, investor access, advanced equipment, and legal advice.

points.title: Venture Capital Fund for Startups
points.description: ₹500 crore Venture Capital Fund managed by an independent expert panel for AI, Deep-Tech, and FinTech startups.

points.title: Tamil Nadu Startup Summit
points.description: An annual conference bringing together startup founders, investors, and industry experts globally.

points.title: EV Vehicles and Battery Manufacturing
points.description: 20,000 public EV fast-charging stations by 2031; 20% cash subsidy for battery cell mega-factories; PLI Scheme for Lithium and Cobalt recycling; ₹10,000 financial support for traditional mechanics to transition to EV mechanics; 50% subsidy (up to ₹50,000) for Residents' Welfare Associations setting up charging infrastructure; 100% motor vehicle tax exemption for commercial EV users for 5 years.

points.title: India's First Commercial Drone Corridor
points.description: Special drone corridors in 10 districts for delivery, agriculture, construction, and disaster management without police permissions. Mandating local drones for police surveillance and agriculture.

points.title: India's First Digital Financial Hub
points.description: Establishment of i-Tamil FinTech Corridor in Coimbatore, reimbursing 30% of cloud server costs in the first 3 years.

points.title: Tamil Nadu as a Global Content Hub; AVGC-XR Creative Economy
points.description: Creative Economy Policy to promote Animation, Visual Effects, Gaming, Comics, and Extended Reality; 25% subsidy for international/national media production costs in TN; AVGC centers in 500 government schools; MSME-like recognition for YouTubers, podcasters, and digital artists; Motion-capture training studios for gaming startups; IP Protection Fund for digital creators; 5-year SGST refund for VFX studios in tier-2/3 towns.

points.title: Space Technology; Kulasekarapattinam Space Research Investment
points.description: Thoothukudi-Tirunelveli region declared Special Space Tech Investment Region with 10-year tax exemptions; ₹100 crore 'Sky Start Seed Fund' for satellite, propulsion, and drone startups.

points.title: Space Technology Infrastructure & Student Research (Continued)
points.description: Government-built space testing centers will be constructed for space research entrepreneurs to use at subsidized rates. Additionally, government funding will be allocated each year for satellites designed by ten engineering college students.

points.title: Green Hydrogen Hub at Thoothukudi Port
points.description: To make Thoothukudi a primary bunkering center for green ammonia for international ships and a primary South Asian port, 10-year incentives and subsidies along with infrastructure facilities will be provided to green hydrogen investors.

points.title: Public Health Protection; ₹25 Lakh Health Insurance for All Families
points.description: A 'Makkal Nalan Insurance' card worth ₹25 lakhs will be provided to every family covering treatments including cancer, heart surgery, dialysis, and robotic surgery.

points.title: Free Full Body Check-up
points.description: Free annual full-body health check-ups for every citizen of Tamil Nadu to monitor health and take early preventive action against conditions like cancer and diabetes.

points.title: Five New Multi-Specialty Hospitals
points.description: Five 500-bed multi-specialty hospitals with Digital ICUs and modern diagnostic facilities will be opened across 5 underdeveloped regions starting from southern Tamil Nadu.

points.title: Modern Primary Health Centres (PHCs)
points.description: All PHCs will be upgraded to 'IPHS 2025' standards with 24/7 readiness of medical staff including 3 doctors, 1 lab technician, and 1 mental health counselor.

points.title: Makkal Nalan Nilayam; 3000 Clinics with Telemedicine
points.description: 3,000 Makkal Nalan Clinics will be established, equipped with a nurse, diagnostic tools, and telemedicine links to nearby PHCs, functioning all week from 7 AM to 9 PM.

points.title: IVF Santhathi Scheme; Infertility Treatment for Childless Couples
points.description: Free IVF (In Vitro Fertilization) centers will be set up across all government district headquarter hospitals and government medical colleges to provide free infertility treatments.

points.title: Modernizing Rural Hospitals
points.description: Rural hospitals will be modernized with 2-bed dialysis units, 4-bed emergency wards, maternity check-ups, operation theatres, and increased rapid ambulance services.

points.title: Low-Cost Medicines
points.description: High-grade paid medicines will be available at all government and medical college hospitals at 50% to 90% cheaper prices than external market rates.

points.title: Happy Tamil Nadu Mission
points.description: A statewide 'Happiness Ecosystem' will be created in partnership with corporations, NGOs, and educational institutions to improve mental health, social harmony, and quality of life.

points.title: Mental Healthcare Initiative
points.description: A 10-bed mental health counseling unit will be opened in every community hospital, a mental health counselor will be appointed in every high school, and ₹500 crore annual budget will be allocated for mental healthcare.

subsection.label: B
subsection.title: Protecting the Future of Tamil Nadu; Concerns on Environment, Forests and Climate Change

points.title: Tamil Nadu as a World-Renowned Siddha Destination
points.description: A Siddha wellness tourism plan will be created, offering government-recognized Siddha rehabilitation certification. Siddha centers will be established in Nilgiris, Kodaikanal, Yercaud, and Courtallam, connected with Siddha tourism towns Tiruvannamalai, Chidambaram, and Courtallam.

points.title: Tamil Nadu Climate Budget ₹3,000 Crore
points.description: A dedicated climate budget of ₹3,000 crore will be allocated solely to transition the state toward renewable energy and attract green investments.

points.title: Zero-Fatality Disaster Management
points.description: Integrated disaster management offices will be set up in all 38 districts, flood prevention infrastructure in 5 coastal cities including Chennai, and dedicated heatwave disaster management offices in all 38 districts.

points.title: Sustainable Energy Economy Division
points.description: A Sustainable Energy Economy Division directly under the Chief Minister's Office will issue green bonds, fund climate innovation, restore water sources, and manage carbon emission reduction plans.

subsection.label: B
subsection.title: Protecting the Future of Tamil Nadu (Continued)

points.title: Green Tamil Nadu Scheme; 33% Forest Cover in 5 Years
points.description: Committed to increasing TN's forest cover to 33% by 2031. Restoration of sandalwood trees in Eastern Ghats with tribal participation, and rehabilitation of indigenous wild animals suited to forest ecosystems.

points.title: Clean Rivers
points.description: Prevention of textile factory waste entering rivers in Erode and Tiruppur. Construction of riverfront parks along the Cauvery in Trichy, Vaigai in Madurai, and Thamirabarani in Tirunelveli.

points.title: Forests and Humans
points.description: Installation of 50 km solar energy fences in forest border areas of 6 districts, 500 forest protection officers with GPS vehicles at night, ₹10 lakh compensation for fatal wildlife attacks, and ₹5 lakh for severe injuries.

points.title: Protection of Mangrove Forests
points.description: Mangrove forests will be integrated with the forest department and protected as eco-conservation zones.

points.title: Pure Air
points.description: Annual allocation of ₹500 crore to control, plan, and monitor air pollution levels in Tamil Nadu.

subsection.label: B
subsection.title: Protecting the Future of Tamil Nadu (Continued)

points.title: Cooum and Adyar Rivers Restoration Mission
points.description: Chennai's Cooum and Adyar rivers will be restored on a mission mode to ensure ecological revival and pollution control.

points.title: Pallikaranai Marshland Protection and Restoration
points.description: Encroachments in the Pallikaranai marshland will be removed, and the wetland will be protected and restored as a vital urban biodiversity zone.

points.title: 24-Hour Uninterrupted Electricity
points.description: Uninterrupted 24-hour power supply will be ensured by connecting 10,000 overloaded feeders and boosting generation capacity under TANGEDCO.

points.title: Solar Subsidy; ₹35,000 for 1kW, ₹70,000 for 2kW, ₹1 Lakh for 3kW+
points.description: Subsidies provided to households installing rooftop solar panels to make Tamil Nadu self-sufficient in power.

points.title: Monthly Electricity Billing
points.description: The current bimonthly electricity billing cycle will be abolished, and monthly electricity billing will be implemented.

points.title: TANGEDCO Reforms; Reducing Electricity Charges for Apartments and MSMEs
points.description: A 5-year restructuring plan to curb power loss and theft (saving ~₹3,000 crore annually), replacement of 18,000 old transformers, reduction of AT&C losses from 16% to 10%, and charging residential rates instead of commercial rates for common areas in apartments (benefiting 30 lakh urban flat residents).

points.title: 50% Renewable Energy Usage
points.description: Targeting 50% renewable energy reliance in public infrastructure, industrial parks, and government facilities across Tamil Nadu.

points.title: Seaport Development
points.description: TVK government will take action to make the Enayam port project in Kanyakumari district fully operational (shelved for 8 years) and upgrade Cuddalore Port into an industrial port[cite: 22].

points.title: Multi-Modal Logistics Parks
points.description: Multi-modal logistics parks integrating freight transport and cargo security will be established in 3 locations: Chennai Port-Rail belt, Western Coimbatore industrial belt, and Southern Thoothukudi, reducing export costs for TN traders by 20% to 30%[cite: 22].

points.title: Tech-Enabled Roads and Accident-Free Traffic
points.description: AI-assisted speed control cameras will prevent traffic violations and accidents in high-risk highway zones[cite: 22]. Good Samaritans helping accident victims (auto/cab/private vehicle drivers) will receive financial rewards and the 'Good Samaritan Life-Saver Award'[cite: 22].

points.title: Damage-Free Highways
points.description: Allocate ₹2,000 crore annually specifically to repair road defects immediately (out of ₹20,000 crore allocated for highways)[cite: 22]. Introduce a mobile app enabling the public to upload photos and report road damage directly[cite: 22].

points.title: Passenger Ship Service from Nagapattinam to Sri Lanka and Malaysia
points.description: TVK government will make arrangements to launch passenger ship services from Nagapattinam port to Colombo and Kuala Lumpur, reviving ancient Tamil maritime travel[cite: 23].

points.title: Roads Connecting All Panchayats
points.description: In the next 5 years, all panchayats will be connected to highways with roads linking schools, primary health centers, and key locations[cite: 23].

points.title: MGNREGS Work Increased to 150 Days
points.description: Rural employment guarantee scheme days will be increased to 150 days with effort to fix appropriate income[cite: 23].

points.title: Model Villages; Urban Infrastructure for 5,000 Villages
points.description: Under TN Integrated Development Scheme, 5,000 villages will be taken as models to build advanced urban-like infrastructure (restoring water bodies, sports grounds, parks, community halls, LED streetlights, doorstep solid waste collection, village forests)[cite: 23]. Model villages will be selected every Pongal, and the best-performing village will receive a ₹50 lakh development prize[cite: 23].

points.title: Rural Industrial Infrastructure Scheme
points.description: Establish 1,000 Village Industry Clusters with integrated infrastructure (work sheds, electricity, water, roads, logistics, cold storage, digital connectivity, worker amenities) to attract MSMEs and startups, creating lakhs of jobs[cite: 24].

points.title: Rural Markets
points.description: Modernize permanent and weekly markets in every village with electronic weighing machines, price display boards, cold storage for green produce, direct links to city wholesalers, and integration with digital sales platforms[cite: 24].

points.title: Slum-Free Cities by 2031
points.description: Provide proper housing, drainage management, and ownership titles to all by 2031 to achieve slum-free cities[cite: 24].

points.title: Cultural Cities Scheme; Protecting Thanjavur, Madurai, Kanchipuram, Mahabalipuram
points.description: Form 'Tamil Nadu Cultural Cities Authority' with special schemes for non-disruptive heritage renovation, drainage repair, special training for local artists/craftsmen, and cultural tourism to boost local economy[cite: 24].

points.title: Climate-Resilient Tamil Nadu Master Plan 2045
points.description: Create a realistic blueprint for sustainable and climate-resilient development across all districts, restoring remaining water bodies/ecosystems, and taking strict action against water body encroachments[cite: 25].

points.title: Flood Prevention for Chennai, Thoothukudi, Cuddalore, Nagapattinam, and Kanyakumari
points.description: Install advanced stormwater drains in flood-risk cities like Chennai[cite: 25]. Protect at least 3% of land area in all municipal corporations as wetlands to recharge groundwater without flooding[cite: 25].

points.title: World-Class Cities: Chennai, Trichy, Madurai, Coimbatore
points.description: Build planned development, relieve housing congestion, modern infrastructure, and modern living standards in Chennai, Trichy, Madurai, and Coimbatore to world-class levels[cite: 25].

points.title: Diverse Parking Facilities
points.description: Introduce various modern parking facilities in corporations through Public-Private Partnerships (PPP)[cite: 25].

points.title: Modern Streets for People
points.description: Create modern pedestrian-friendly streets across 25 municipal corporations with connected roads, footpaths, dedicated cycle tracks, cross-street connectivity, and modern LED streetlights[cite: 25].

points.title: Public Toilet Infrastructure Scheme
points.description: Build 1.5 lakh public toilets along 1 lakh km of urban roads (ensuring toilet access within 500m to 1 km)[cite: 26]. Provide clean/safe toilet facilities at petrol bunks, bus stands, metro, and railway stations[cite: 26].

points.title: Property Tax Reduction
points.description: Introduce new and fair property tax structure to reduce tax burden on residential homeowners imposed by DMK government[cite: 26].

section.title: People's Government; Honest and Transparent Governance

points.title: No-Application Scheme for Welfare Delivery
points.description: Tamil Nadu will become the first state in India to implement a 'No-Application' welfare delivery system within 5 to 7 years, identifying eligible beneficiaries via digital records (Aadhaar, Ration Card, family data), delivering benefits directly to doorstep via 'CM's Public Service Friend' without paperwork, bribes, or application hassle[cite: 27].

points.title: Right to Services Act
points.description: Enact law within 100 days of taking office to ensure timely legal delivery of 500 essential government services (birth certificates, land pattas, caste certificates)[cite: 27].

section.title: People's Government; Honest and Transparent Governance

subsection.label: A & B
subsection.title: 21st Century Government & Citizens as Guides of Government

points.title: Vetri Tamil Nadu Super App
points.description: Enable citizens to access 500 government services (birth certificate, ration card, driving license renewal) directly from mobile phones[cite: 28].

points.title: Rights Cards for Non-Exclusionary Service
points.description: Issue a Rights Card for every family (like Aadhaar) so eligible families easily receive scheme benefits without political interference[cite: 28].

points.title: Tamil Nadu Real-Time Governance Dashboard
points.description: Real-time online portal uploading government income/expenditure, constituency/district scheme allocations, public complaints, and official answers[cite: 28].

points.title: Makkal Arangam (People's Forum)
points.description: Digital platform for direct complaints[cite: 28]. Petitions with 10,000 digital signatures will be reviewed; petitions with 500,000 signatures will trigger a full-day debate in the Legislative Assembly[cite: 28].

section.title: People's Government; Honest and Transparent Governance

subsection.label: B & C
subsection.title: Citizens as Guides & Zero Tolerance Against Corruption

points.title: Vetri Tamil Nadu Platform
points.description: Platform for citizens to share ideas, give feedback on schemes, and evaluate government services[cite: 29].

points.title: Participatory Budgeting; 10% District Funds Voted by Public
points.description: 10% of district development funds voted on by citizens for projects of their choice[cite: 29]. Form a 10-member district monitoring committee (women, youth, SC/ST, experts) to track expenditure[cite: 29].

points.title: Anti-Corruption Helpline
points.description: Post complaint number in all government offices[cite: 29]. Whistleblowers filing complaints to CMO protected under State Whistleblower Protection Act[cite: 29].

points.title: Strengthening Lokayukta
points.description: Grant independent powers to prosecute corrupt officials and elected representatives with transparent appointments[cite: 29].

section.title: People's Government; Honest and Transparent Governance

subsection.label: C & D
subsection.title: Zero Tolerance Against Corruption & Law and Order

points.title: Tamil Nadu Vigilance Wing
points.description: Tech-enabled vigilance wing monitoring procurement, welfare distribution records, and transactions in real-time to prevent corruption before it happens[cite: 30].

points.title: Eradication of Illegal Sand Mining
points.description: Sand and mineral extraction permitted only through transparent public auctions and strictly according to law[cite: 30].

points.title: Drug-Free Tamil Nadu
points.description: Create Anti-Drug Force directly under CM, apply Goondas Act to drug sellers, establish Anti-Drug Clubs in schools, set up Rehabilitation Fund, and award ₹10 lakh special infrastructure grant to drug-free villages[cite: 30].

points.title: Healthy Drug-Free Tamil Nadu / Phased Alcohol Reduction
points.description: Phased reduction of alcohol availability, strong rehab programs, immediate closure or relocation of TASMAC shops near schools and temples[cite: 30].

section.title: People's Government; Honest and Transparent Governance

subsection.label: D & E
subsection.title: Law and Order & Five Special Sub-Budgets

points.title: Justice for Victims of Custodial Deaths
points.description: Custodial deaths reflect government failure[cite: 32]. Under TVK rule, an independent investigation will be conducted to deliver justice to families of victims of custodial deaths that occurred under the DMK regime, and strict action will be taken without bias against all perpetrators of such violence[cite: 32].

points.title: Judicial Infrastructure Improvement & Case Pendency Reduction
points.description: New local courts will be established to reduce the backlog of pending cases in courts and to make access to justice easier for the public[cite: 32].

points.title: Zero Tolerance for Illegal Alcohol Sales
points.description: TVK is committed to fully eradicating the production and sale of fake, illicit, and black-market alcohol[cite: 32]. Treating this as a grave crime, strict legal action will be taken against sellers, suppliers, and accomplices[cite: 32].

points.title: Five Special Sub-Budgets (First Time in India)
points.description: For the first time in India, five special sub-budgets will be presented where allocated funds, scheme execution, beneficiary reach, and societal impact will be strictly monitored and analyzed[cite: 32]: 1) Social Justice Sub-Budget: Funds allocated for women, SC/ST, and marginalized communities will be spent fully without any diversion[cite: 32].

section.title: People's Government; Honest and Transparent Governance

points.title: Five Special Sub-Budgets (Continued)
points.description: 2) Balanced Regional Development Sub-Budget: Address revenue disparities (currently 3:1 between developed and backward districts) with unbiased development plans for backward districts including 12 most backward districts[cite: 33]. 3) TN Cultural & Heritage Sub-Budget: Allocation for excavation site protection, funding for ongoing Keeladi excavations and next phases, and taking Tamil culture global[cite: 33]. 4) Equal Opportunity in Education & Healthcare Sub-Budget: Bridge urban-rural quality gaps, fill teacher/doctor/nurse vacancies immediately, and provide world-class education for all children and healthcare for all citizens[cite: 33]. 5) Ecology Sub-Budget: Dedicated budget for marine resource protection, greening dry districts, urban flood management, eco-friendly agriculture, and climate change mitigation[cite: 33].

points.title: Transforming Tamil Nadu into an Economically Sovereign State
points.description: Noting that Tamil Nadu's debt exceeds ₹10.71 lakh crore in FY 2026-27 and criticizing previous DMK debt spending, TVK commits to building economic structures without imposing new taxes on citizens, preventing revenue loss, increasing income, and prioritizing public spending over wastefulness[cite: 33].

subsection.label: F
subsection.title: Economic Sovereignty; We Will Increase Revenue, Prevent Losses, and Build New Resources

points.title: New Avenues for Revenue Growth (continued from Point 1)
points.description: The TVK government will pursue revenue growth through new approaches, including eliminating corruption, uniting overseas Tamils to attract fresh investment, revitalising small-scale industries, and adopting new revenue-growth methods rooted in technology, environmental sustainability and knowledge-driven systems.

points.title: Tamil Nadu Strategic Investment Authority (TNSIA)
points.description:
Moving away from a system that relies solely on taxes and grants, the TVK government will steer Tamil Nadu towards a new economic model focused on wealth creation. While earlier governments relied only on tax policy and concessions, the TVK government will establish a Strategic Investment Authority with capital of Rs. 50,000 crore.

Through this authority, the government will directly invest as a stakeholder in high-growth sectors such as semiconductors, electric vehicles (EVs), aerospace, artificial intelligence (AI) and advanced manufacturing. Rather than merely coordinating investments, under TVK rule the Tamil Nadu government will invest directly alongside industry, create new value and share in its ownership. This will generate large-scale, high-quality employment opportunities while also creating new non-tax revenue sources for the state.

points.title: White Paper on State Financial Position and Debt Management
points.description: The TVK government will release a comprehensive White Paper covering Tamil Nadu's fiscal position, debt levels, borrowing practices, revenue utilisation, and missed economic opportunities. This will serve as the foundation for transparent, accountable and growth-oriented fiscal strategies going forward.

points.title: Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) Turnaround Plan
points.description: To improve the operational efficiency of public sector undertakings, increase their profitability, and reduce financial burden, the TVK government will implement structural reforms across all PSUs. In addition, sector-specific experts will be appointed to strengthen management, and professional management practices will be introduced.
